text: Blessed man, blessed woman, who fear God, Who cherish and relish his commandments,
And the homes of the upright—how blessed!
And a generosity that never runs dry.
God's grace and mercy and justice!
The good person is generous and lends lavishly;
But a sterling and solid and lasting reputation.
A generosity that goes on, and on, and on. An honored life! A beautiful life!
Blusters away but ends up speechless. There's nothing to the dreams of the wicked. Nothing.
